response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count FROM account AS a JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id) SELECT dist.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client)) AS avg_share_of_all_clients FROM district_counts AS dc JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = dc.district_id GROUP BY dist.A3
